facts.fact: The report states the Ministry of Health, with WHO technical support, produced and launched the Health Statistics Abstract (2025) at the Fourth South Sudan Health Summit, 2-5 December 2025, launched by the Vice President.

note: Only the Health Statistics Abstract launch is a fact; no civil-registration vital statistics report is stated (Trends in Deaths by Cause is not said to come from civil registration); DHIS2 audit and EWARS linkage are an information system with no product named.
